title: Verify: Bedroom content validity unit tests
summary: Tests that the shipped content loads, validates and has required objects
description: Load the real content files with loadWorld and assert required structure.
acceptance_criteria: Given shipped content, when validated, then no errors.
Given the scene, then required objects and opening text exist.

steps.action: Add tests using loadWorld(resolve(__dirname,'../content/worlds/the-boys-room')): 'content has no reference errors' asserts validateWorld returns []; 'opening dialogue text' asserts the intro node text equals "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?" and speaker 'boy'; 'has required objects' asserts object ids include bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window, door; 'bookshelf search sets flag' calls performAction on an initial state and asserts flags.secret_door_open true.
steps.command: cd backend/game && npx vitest run tests/content.test.ts
